predict: REARANK stands for Reasoning Re-ranking Agent via Reinforcement Learning. It is a large language model (LLM)-based listwise reasoning reranking agent that uses reinforcement learning with explicit reasoning. REARANK is a proposed reranking agent that aims to improve the ranking of items, and it has been developed and evaluated in various studies, demonstrating comparable or even superior performance to powerful models like GPT4. Specifically, there is a variant called REARANK-7B, which is based on the Qwen2.5-7B model trained with a reinforcement learning approach and reasoning ability.
